messages.author: Maren Achterberg
messages.text: AP-DK-0107 is Quayside on the contracted week with a deposit up to 3,000, or a Fennimore week that finishes by 10 July, and at most 2,500 of incremental travel. Above that is Ifeoma. Nobody has asked for an exception.

messages.author: Rui Saldanha
messages.text: If the board moves: Inês, Liam, and Wei Ling are basic fares — forfeited, new tickets at 380 on NL-1215. The four flex fares re-issue for their recorded fees. Open-market rebooking above the caps is not something I can sign alone.

messages.author: Nadia Ferreira (Quayside)
messages.text: Both assembly rooms are open the week of 29 June; QA-6610 stands until the 19th and a hold takes the 20% deposit.
